newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to raise product prices for December.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to raise product prices for December.

text.p: Leading Japanese refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise the wholesale price of its oil products by 1,400 yen per kilolitre (kl) effective from December 1.
The increase reflects a surge in crude oil prices in October and a weaker yen, Nippon Oil said in a news release.

Following market deregulation in April, major Japanese refiners adopted a wholesale pricing system taking into account international prices of crude and oil products as well as moves on the currency market.
Other Japanese oil companies are likely to announce similar increases in the following days.
Last month, Japanese oil companies raised their wholesale prices by more than 1,000 yen.
